text:
kai: Heads-up — onboarding Cerulean's LoRA adapter into staging for their chat product. Want a quick smoke pack run (dialog quality + safety) before we canary. Can anyone pick this up? :eyes:

anita: I'll take it. Do we have the baseline outputs and a tokenizer map? Also what's the quant target — fp16/int8/int4?

kai: Baseline is base-cerulean-v1 (fp16). Customer sent lora-cerulean-v2. They want int4 for cost. Quickpack is s3://redwood-evals/cerulean/quick50.json — please run both fp16 and int4 for comparison.

trevor: FYI we saw a token-shift with int4 on a different adapter last month — emojis/punctuation got clipped in the 4-bit remap. Keep an eye on tokenizer diffs & per-token alignment.

elen: Ran the fp16 merged run on staging (merged/cerulean-lora-v2 -> fp16) — quick numbers: BLEU 0.61 -> 0.58, ROUGE-L 0.44 -> 0.41, hallucination rate 3% -> 9%. Full outputs attached in /tmp but here's a short sample.

elen: ```
$ python tools/run_eval.py --pack s3://redwood-evals/cerulean/quick50.json \
  --model merged/cerulean-lora-v2 --quant fp16 --out /tmp/cer_eval_fp16.json
...
User: "When will my order arrive?"
Baseline: "Your order shipped on 2025-05-22, expected 3-5 business days."
Merged LoRA: "It should arrive tomorrow."   <-- unsupported confident hallucination
```

josh: Can you dump per-token probs / argmax diffs? If the merge changes tokenization, sampling settings could amplify the effect. Also try deterministic decoding (greedy) to check core logits.

anita: int4 run finished. Bad news: BLEU 0.52, hallucination ~12%. Tokenizer diff shows emdash (—) mapping changed: baseline had single token 0x2014, merged int4 mapping returns two tokens [226, 128]. That's definitely shifting context windows on a lot of prompts.

trevor: If tokenization mapping changed post-merge, int4 merge pipeline probably didn't re-run the tokenizer alignment pass. We generally need to: 1) re-derive tokenizer id mapping, 2) remap adapter merges to consistent token ids, or 3) forbid int4 until mapping validated.

kai: Proposed plan: (1) revert canary in staging, (2) attempt token remap + rebuild int4 artifacts, (3) run focused A/B with 20% traffic and automatic fallback to base-cerulean-v1 on hallucination threshold. @anita take point on remap, @elen run smoke after rebuild.

deploy-bot: Rolling back canary for merged/cerulean-lora-v2 -> previous stable (base-cerulean-v1). Reason: quality regressions detected by smoke pack. Deploy ID: d-cer-2401234567. :warning:

anita: On it — starting token-remap pass now. Steps: pull adapter checkpoint, re-run merge-tool --align-token-ids, rebuild int4 quant with quant-tool v2.3. ETA ~2h. I'll post logs.

elen: I'll prepare a split regression prompt set (20 safety-critical + 30 customer dialogs) and a diff viewer to highlight tokenized prefixes. Will run greedy + top-p=0.95 for parity.

josh: Also add a deterministic eval (greedy) for comparison so we can separate sampling variance from underlying model drift.

trevor: If remap doesn't fix it, fallback is to keep customer on fp16 or route to dedicated pool until we can certify int4. Note implications for cost commit.

kai: Agreed. Thanks team. Ping me once remap logs show success and you have new smoke numbers. :thumbsup:

anita: log head (posting as I start):
```
[INFO] pulling adapter lora-cerulean-v2 from s3://cust-cerulean/adapters/lora-v2.ckpt
[INFO] running merge-tool --align-token-ids --base-tokenizer s3://models/base-cerulean/tokenizer.json
[INFO] remap table entries: 12 mismatches detected, applying fixups
[INFO] rebuilding quant artifacts with quant-tool v2.3 --bits 4
```

elen: Great, will queue the smoke run as soon as build artifacts are up. Leaving regression checks in the workflow: halluc_rate < 5% AND BLEU drop < 0.03 for canary to proceed.

kai: Perfect. We'll document findings in the Cerulean onboarding ticket and schedule a short sync if needed. Thanks everyone.
